gloss: worthy rival; good opponent; well-matched competitor

definitions.gloss: worthy rival; good opponent; well-matched competitor
definitions.explanation: A rival or competitor whose skill level closely matches one's own, making the competition both challenging and stimulating. Implies mutual respect between competitors.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}にとって{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is a worthy rival to me.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{長年|ながねん}の{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}として{互|たが}いを{高|たか}め{合|あ}ってきた。
examples.english: The two have pushed each other to improve as long-time rivals.

examples.japanese: よい{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}がいたからこそ、ここまで{成長|せいちょう}できたのだと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think it was precisely because I had a good rival that I was able to grow this much.

notes:
USAGE:
{好敵手|こうてきしゅ} has a positive connotation. It implies that the rivalry brings out the best in both parties. The ライバル (rival) loanword is more common in casual speech, while {好敵手|こうてきしゅ} is more literary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好敵手|こうてきしゅ}と{競|きそ}う (to compete with a worthy rival)
- {生涯|しょうがい}の{好敵手|こうてきしゅ} (a lifelong rival)
- {好敵手|こうてきしゅ}に{恵|めぐ}まれる (to be blessed with a good rival)

ETYMOLOGY:
{好|こう} (good, favorable) + {敵手|てきしゅ} (opponent). Literally "a good opponent" — someone whose opposition is welcome because it drives improvement.
